query: SELECT MAX(f.position) AS "position?: i64", MIN(f.epoch) AS "minimum_epoch?: i64", MAX(f.epoch) AS "maximum_epoch?: i64" FROM posts p CROSS JOIN project_feed f INDEXED BY feed_by_record ON f.record_kind = 'post' AND f.record_id = p.post_id WHERE p.thread_id = ? AND p.post_id != ? AND f.position <= ?
